name: Dashie - GTA 6
creator: Dashie
notes: Dashie is funniest when he is NOT trying to be: he's overconfident and then fails immediately, confidently explains something wrong, gets confused by simple things, talks to/argues with NPCs as if they're real people, makes random noises/voices, panics over nothing, reacts dramatically to a small thing, or deadpans while chaos happens. Prioritise those over generic loud moments. GTA 6 is brand new, so first reactions to new mechanics, Vice City/Leonida details, wild NPCs ('Florida man' energy), police chases, wanted-level escapes, ragdoll/physics fails and car crashes are high value. Hashtags: game-specific first (#gta6 #gtavi #gta6clips), then #dashie #gaming.

fail: This is why he can't have nice things 😂
funny: He didn't mean to be this funny 😂
